No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

On this walk you study a major Buddhist monastic learning landscape using excavated plans.

The date, start time, pace and language are arranged to suit your group.

What it covers

  • Site orientation and chronology
  • Monastic residential remains
  • Sacred structures and material interpretation
  • Learning networks evidence clinic

How the time is spent

  1. Site orientation and chronology 30 min

  2. Monastic residential remains 45 min

  3. Sacred structures and material interpretation 55 min

  4. Learning networks evidence clinic 50 min

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Place the excavated remains of Nalanda in a chronology using the site plan.
  • Identify monastic residential remains and sacred structures, and interpret their materials.
  • Assess the evidence for learning networks connected to the monastic landscape of Nalanda.

You take away

An interpretation sheet with questions to ask on site and suggested reading.
